question: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY ) now has in excess of 472 million accounts. Which state has topped this List ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of October 12, 2022, the state with the highest number of Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts is Uttar Pradesh tops the list with 84,341,592 
 
• This is followed by Bihar with 29,949,585 accounts, and Andhra Pradesh with 18,917,437 accounts.
 
• This likely contributed to the high number of PMJDY accounts in the state.
 
• Additionally, the state government has been actively promoting the scheme, and it has made it easy for people to open accounts.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a financial inclusion program launched by the Government of India in August 2014.
 
• It aims to provide 'universal access to banking facilities' with at least one basic banking account for every household, financial literacy, access to credit, insurance, and pension facility.
 
• The initiative also includes providing a RuPay debit card with inbuilt accident insurance coverage.
 
• The scheme is intended to connect more people, especially those from rural areas and the unorganized sector, to the formal banking system
